notes.title: Hikari! Love Potion Coming Soon!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33587075/c9472765a53de0dc29514a32a3e54e1483838e7d.jpg[/img]
We just made the store page live for Hikari! Love Potion on Steam! Go get your wishlists in so you'll be prepared once it releases on August 30th! It will be available uncensored, no need for any patching or DLCs.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1132710/Hikari_Love_Potion/

You can check out their other game Hikari! Clover Rescue on Steam as well.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/979330/Hikari_Clover_Rescue/

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33587075/e4da079853ebb8a7bbc9c38f75e29f5f6094dc5b.png[/img]
And in case you missed it, we just released another uncensored game called I Walk Among Zombies Vol. 2! Of course Vol. 1 is available on Steam as well.  
https://store.steampowered.com/app/942850/I_Walk_Among_Zombies_Vol_1/
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1100800/I_Walk_Among_Zombies_Vol_2/
